incidents.summary: Piper Alderman filed a class action against IG Markets alleging that it promoted CFDs to inexperienced traders without adequate safeguards.

sources.title: IG Group
sources.quote: In May 2023, the law firm Piper Alderman filed a class action against IG Markets, accusing the company of promoting contracts for difference (CFDs) to inexperienced traders without proper safeguards.

sources.title: IG are getting sued - TradeInformer
sources.quote: The lawyers said the total losses of investors with IG Markets exceed [AUD]$800 million.

incidents.summary: The Supreme Court of Western Australia ruled that IG's manifest-error clause was unfair and void, requiring it to pay a customer AU$5.5 million.

sources.title: IG Group
sources.quote: In November 2025, in Tomasso v IG Markets Ltd (Supreme Court of Western Australia), the court ruled that IG's "manifest error" contract clause was unfair and therefore void under Australian consumer law.

sources.title: IG Group
sources.quote: IG was required to pay a customer AU$5.5 million after it attempted to cancel trades under that clause.

incidents.summary: Following a trading-platform failure that caused significant losses to more than 370 clients, the Financial Ombudsman Service ordered IG to compensate affected customers around £1 million.

sources.title: IG Group
sources.quote: In January 2015, more than 370 clients incurred significant losses following a failure of IG's trading platform during a volatile market event.

sources.title: IG Group
sources.quote: In June 2015, the Financial Ombudsman Service ordered IG to compensate affected customers around £1 million in total.

incidents.summary: FINRA fined IG subsidiary tastytrade $30,000 for inadequate supervision of employees' outside securities accounts over a two-year period.

sources.title: FINRA Sanctions IG Group's tastytrade for Alleged Two-Year Compliance Lapse
sources.quote: FINRA has imposed a $30,000 fine on tastytrade, a Chicago-based retail trading platform and the US subsidiary of publicly listed broker IG Group (LSE: IGG), for failing to properly supervise its employees' outside securities accounts over a two-year period.

sources.title: FINRA Sanctions IG Group's tastytrade for Alleged Two-Year Compliance Lapse
sources.quote: The Chicago-based retail trading platform agreed to settle without admitting or denying the findings.

incidents.summary: IG Securities disclosed that 162,879 customers' personal data may have been accessible within IG Group, while reporting no detected leakage outside the group.

sources.title: IG Group
sources.quote: In April 2026, IG Securities, IG's Japanese subsidiary, disclosed that personal data of 162,879 customers may have been accessible within the IG group.

sources.title: IG Group
sources.quote: Records of 29,734 customers had been stored on an external server, but the company said it had not detected any data leakage outside IG Group.

positives: An independent report states that IG directed over £3.8 million to community initiatives in fiscal 2025.
